H6997.name: Hakkatan
H6997.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6997.brief: Father of Johanan, a leader who returned from Babylon.
H6997.short: Hakkatan was the father of Johanan, a leader who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian exile.

H6976H.name: Hakkoz
H6976H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6976H.brief: A priest in the time of David.
H6976H.short: Hakkoz was a priest who served during the reign of King David, as mentioned in the priestly divisions.

H6976I.name: Hakkoz
H6976I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6976I.brief: A post-exilic priest whose descendants were excluded from the priesthood.
H6976I.short: Hakkoz was a priest whose descendants were unable to prove their priestly lineage after the Babylonian exile.

H6976J.name: Hakkoz
H6976J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6976J.brief: A priest who helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.
H6976J.short: Hakkoz, a priest, was involved in repairing sections of the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H6934.name: Kadmiel
H6934.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6934.brief: A Levite who returned from Babylonian exile
H6934.short: Kadmiel was a Levite who returned from Babylonian exile and played a significant role in the rebuilding of the temple and the spiritual renewal of the people.

H6935.name: Kadmonites
H6935.short: The Kadmonites were one of the Canaanite people groups living in the land promised to Abraham's descendants.

H6938.name: Kedar
H6938.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6938.brief: A son of Ishmael and a nomadic tribe
H6938.short: Kedar was a son of Ishmael and the eponymous ancestor of a nomadic Arab tribe known for their tents and flocks.

H6929.name: Kedemah
H6929.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6929.brief: A son of Ishmael; Nodab, a Hagrite tribe
H6929.short: Kedemah was a son of Ishmael, while the Nodab were a Hagrite tribe defeated by the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh.

H6989.name: Keturah
H6989.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H6989.short: Keturah was the concubine Abraham took after the death of Sarah, and she bore him six sons.

H6955.name: Kohath
H6955.desc: Levi's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6955.brief: Son of Levi; Levite clan ancestor
H6955.short: Kohath, son of Levi, was the ancestor of Moses and Aaron.

H6964H.name: Kolaiah
H6964H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6964H.short: Kolaiah, a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon.

H6964G.name: Kolaiah
H6964G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H6964G.short: Kolaiah, a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem.

H6981G.name: Kore
H6981G.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6981G.short: Kore, a Levite gatekeeper, descendant of Korah

H6981H.name: Kore
H6981H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H6981H.brief: Levite in charge of freewill offerings
H6981H.short: Kore, a Levite in charge of distributing freewill offerings during Hezekiah's reign.

H6976G.name: Koz
H6976G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H6976G.short: Koz, a descendant of Judah through Ashhur.

H6924A.name: East
H6924A.brief: A direction associated with invading armies and nomadic tribes.
H6924A.short: In the Bible, the East is often associated with invading armies and nomadic tribes (<ref="Judges 6:3, 33; 7:12; 8:10; Ezk.25.4, 10">Judges 6:3, 33; 7:12; 8:10; Ezk.25.4, 10</ref>).

H6944J.name: Holy Place
H6944J.brief: The inner sanctuary of the Tabernacle and Temple
H6944J.short: The Holy Place was the inner sanctuary of the Tabernacle and Temple.

H6909.name: Kabzeel
H6909.brief: A town in the Negev, home of Benaiah
H6909.short: Kabzeel, a town in the Negev, was the hometown of Benaiah, one of David's mighty men (<ref="Joshua 15:21; 2Sa.23.20; 1Ch.11.22">Joshua 15:21; 2Sa.23.20; 1Ch.11.22</ref>).

H6946G.name: Kadesh
H6946G.brief: An important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin
H6946G.short: Kadesh (Kadesh-barnea, En-mishpat), an important oasis in the Wilderness of Zin, was a key location during the Israelites' wilderness wanderings.

H6932.name: Kedemoth
H6932.brief: A town in Moab, later a Levitical city in Reuben
H6932.short: Kedemoth, a town in Moab from which Moses sent messengers to Sihon, later became a Levitical city within the territory of Reuben (<ref="Deu.2.26; Joshua 13:18; 21:37; 1Ch.6.79">Deu.2.26; Joshua 13:18; 21:37; 1Ch.6.79</ref>).

H6943G.name: Kedesh
H6943G.brief: A Canaanite city, later a Levitical city of refuge in Naphtali
H6943G.short: Kedesh (Kedesh-naphtali), a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua, became a Levitical city and a city of refuge in the territory of Naphtali (<ref="Joshua 12:22; 19:37; 20:7; 21:32">Joshua 12:22; 19:37; 20:7; 21:32</ref>).

H6954.name: Kehelathah
H6954.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey
H6954.short: Kehelathah, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings after leaving Mount Sinai (<ref="Numbers 33:22-23">Numbers 33:22-23</ref>).

H6914.name: Kibroth-hattaavah
H6914.brief: A place where the Israelites complained and were punished
H6914.short: Kibroth-hattaavah, meaning "graves of craving," was a place where the Israelites complained about the lack of meat and were punished with a plague (<ref="Numbers 11:34-35; 33:16-17; Deu.9.22">Numbers 11:34-35; 33:16-17; Deu.9.22</ref>).

H6911.name: Kibzaim
H6911.brief: A Levitical city in the territory of Ephraim
H6911.short: Kibzaim, also known as Jokmeam, was a Levitical city within the territory of Ephraim (<ref="Joshua 21:22; 1Ch.6.68">Joshua 21:22; 1Ch.6.68</ref>).

H6939.name: Kidron
H6939.brief: A valley east of Jerusalem, site of significant events
H6939.short: The Kidron Valley, also known as the Valley of Jehoshaphat, is located east of Jerusalem and was the site of several significant events in the Bible.

H6970.name: Koa
H6970.brief: A people group mentioned by Ezekiel
H6970.short: Koa, a people group mentioned by Ezekiel (<ref="Ezk.23.23">Ezk.23.23</ref>).

H6944H.name: Most Holy Place
H6944H.brief: The innermost room of the tabernacle and temple
H6944H.short: The Most Holy Place was the innermost room of the tabernacle and temple, where the Ark of the Covenant was kept.
